_doc: Optional. Each entry is one major body of work. match finds the bullets (or resume lines) about it; at least one of those must also contain a mechanisms term, which names HOW the work was done (the method, technique, protocol, or process), not only its size or its outcome. Checked by: node scripts/check-evidence-depth.js (whole bullet library), node scripts/check-evidence-depth.js --resume <resume.json> (one resume), and as a warning when a resume is rendered (blocking under --strict). Leave systems empty to skip the check. The _examples block is ignored by the script; copy its shape, not its content.
